findings.claim: The course intake's Concept-day allocation for S20 (authoring/evidence/html-css-js/intake.md, section Block allocation per day) schedules topic videos only in the 8-minute Short video block, 'topic videos whose runtimes sum to 8 minutes or less across the day (a video that does not fit is recorded absent with the reason)'. The four S20 companions assign 7.30 (semantic), 2.22 (forms), 7.57 (accessibility) and 8.37 (box model) optional watch minutes, 25.46 minutes in all, so at most one or two of them fit the block. This 8.37-minute whole-video assignment exceeds the 8-minute block on its own, so under the intake rule it cannot be scheduled even if it were the only S20 video.
findings.recommendation: Assign a sub-segment that fits and serves the objectives (for example the four areas and box-sizing parts, 0:00 to 3:49 and 6:10 to 8:22, or one of them) or record the video as unscheduled/absent with the reason, per the intake.

findings.claim: The body says the coverage is 'Per its chapters, description and captions' while the cautions (line 53) say 'the video has no chapters'. The description has no timestamps either, so the stated provenance contradicts itself.
findings.recommendation: Change line 40 to 'Per its caption track' (or name the actual source of the time ranges) so the body and the cautions agree.

findings.claim: The covers list gives margin collapsing a 3:49 to 6:10 range, but the o3 gap says it is 'mentioned briefly'. The gap also does not say whether the video covers the page's exceptions (horizontal margins and flex or grid items never collapse). A beginner who learns only 'vertical margins collapse' from the video may over-apply it, and the page's own setup 2 (flex column, 50px gap) tests exactly that exception.
findings.recommendation: Make the covers line and the gap agree on how much time collapse gets, and add to the o3 gap that the exceptions the page teaches (horizontal margins, flex and grid items) are page-only unless the captions show otherwise.
